==Description==
'''Ascended''' is an emote that could have been obtained from General III of the [[PVP Season 0]]. The emote is looped and the player cannot move while performing this emote. It is not interactable and no music can be heard from it. Sounds can be heard while performing this emote.

When used, the player will begin to fly in the air using a pair of yellow wings. After a while, they will smash the ground beneath them.
